section_name: Use the second technical cluster to contextualize mean absolute error and mean squared error

candidates.title: Theoria combinationis observationum erroribus minimis obnoxiae
candidates.reason: In this foundational work, Carl Friedrich Gauss formally introduced the concept of mean squared error (evaluating the precision of estimators via expected squared error) in contrast to Pierre-Simon Laplace's mean absolute error criterion, establishing the basis for the Gauss-Markov theorem and optimal linear estimation.
